references.role: heatmaps, responder/validation panels, categorical accents, compact multi-panel composition

rules: Use white/off-white backgrounds and thin axes.
Do not use seaborn defaults or decorative gradients.
Use the same semantic color for the same concept across all figures.
Show numerator and denominator directly for validation metrics when possible.
Do not visually rescue null, non-computable, or low-power disease results.
Use saturated accent colors only for technically meaningful contrasts or validated signal.
Panel labels are bold uppercase letters aligned consistently at top-left.
